devdoc.details: This contract allows users to deposit USDC tokens, create orders, and match those orders      against USD0 tokens provided by other users.      Order matching works by allowing users to create individual orders specifying the amount      of USDC tokens they wish to swap. Other users can then provide USD0 tokens to match against      these orders, directly swapping their USD0 tokens for the USDC tokens in the orders.      Tradeoffs:      + Direct swaps: Users can directly swap their tokens with each other, without the need for        intermediary liquidity pools.      + Low Slippage: The price of the swap is determined by the usdc oracle price at that block height irrespective of liquidity depth.      - Liquidity: Order matching relies on the presence of active orders to facilitate swaps.        If there are no matching orders available, users may need to wait for new orders to be created.      - Match to Market: The price of the swaps is determined by the individual orders when they are executed not when they are placed (offset by low price volatility of stables)

depositUSDC(uint256).details: This function transfers the specified amount of USDC tokens from the caller to the contract      and creates a new order with the deposited amount and the caller as the requester.

params.amountToDeposit: The amount of USDC tokens to deposit.

depositUSDCWithPermit(uint256,uint256,ui.details: This function transfers the specified amount of USDC tokens from the caller to the contract      and creates a new order with the deposited amount and the caller as the requester.

params.amountToDeposit: The amount of USDC tokens to deposit.
params.r: The r value for the permit
params.s: The s value for the permit
params.v: The v value for the permit

getNextOrderId().details: This function returns the next order ID, which is the total number of orders created.

getOrder(uint256).details: This function returns the active status and token amount of the specified order.

params.orderId: The unique identifier of the order.

returns.active: A boolean indicating whether the order is active or not.
returns.tokenAmount: The amount of USDC tokens associated with the order.

minimumUSDCAmountProvided().details: This function retrieves the minimum USDC amount from the storage variable.

returns.minimumUSDCAmount: The minimum USDC amount required for providing liquidity.

pause().details: This function can only be called by a pauser.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

provideUsd0ReceiveUSDC(address,uint256,u.details: This function allows users to specify an amount of USDC tokens they want, calculating the corresponding      USD0 tokens they need and exchanging it against active orders.

params.amountUsdcToTakeInNativeDecimals: The amount of USDC tokens to take, in the token's native decimal representation.
params.orderIdsToTake: An array of order IDs to match against.
params.partialMatchingAllowed: A flag indicating whether partial matching is allowed.
params.recipient: The address to receive the USDC tokens.

returns._0: The unmatched amount of USDC tokens.

provideUsd0ReceiveUSDCWithPermit(address.details: This function allows users to to swap their USD0 for USDC with permit

params.amountUsdcToTakeInNativeDecimals: The amount of USDC tokens to take, in the token's native decimal representation.
params.orderIdsToTake: An array of order IDs to match against.
params.partialMatchingAllowed: A flag indicating whether partial matching is allowed.
params.r: The r value for the permit
params.recipient: The address to receive the USDC tokens.
params.s: The s value for the permit
params.usd0ToPermit: The amount of USD0 tokens to permit, must be greater than the equivalent amount of USDC tokens to take.
params.v: The v value for the permit

returns._0: The unmatched amount of USDC tokens.

swapUsd0(address,uint256,uint256[],bool).details: This function handles the precision differences between USD0 and USDC taking dust into account      to ensure accurate conversion. It returns the unmatched USD0 amount in WAD format, including the dust.

params.amountUsd0ToProvideInWad: The amount of USD0 to provide in WAD format.
params.orderIdsToTake: An array of order IDs to match against.
params.partialMatchingAllowed: A flag indicating whether partial matching is allowed.
params.recipient: The address to receive the USDC tokens.

returns._0: The unmatched amount of Usd0 tokens in WAD format.

unpause().details: This function can only be called by an administrator.

updateMinimumUSDCAmountProvided(uint256).details: This function can only be called by an administrator.

params.minimumUSDCAmount: The new minimum amount of USDC to deposit        The new minimumUSDCAmount must be greater than 1 USDC (1e6)

withdrawUSDC(uint256).details: This function deactivates the specified order, sets its token amount to zero, and transfers      the deposited USDC tokens back to the requester.

params.orderToCancel: The ID of the order to cancel and withdraw from.
